items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And later on, Jeff Brunt had a place, the Atlantis Club, right next to that.

ctx.x: So what were some of the places that you dropped in on, for instance.

Well, there was like Connies Inn, sometimes. And there was Goldgraben's around there. And Edmunds had a place and Connors had a place there on 135th Street, and Edmunds was on 5th Avenue. And there was -- Happy Rhone's was over there where the Cotton Club was eventually put up there. And later on, Jeff Brunt had a place, the Atlantis Club, right next to that. Oh, there was quite a lot of places. And then there was some after hours places. I didn't bother about playing in them, but we used to go to them when we…
What about places that didn't feature music. Where performers would hang out. What places were there?
